orchestration.grouping: one immutable candidate fit per task
orchestration.compilerCacheScope: isolated per candidate task; no cross-task compile lock
orchestration.linearAlgebraRuntime: OpenBLAS with one thread per SVI worker

endpoints.primary: full-coverage selection objective: 65% mean selected excess loss plus 35% P90 selected excess loss

primaryInference.superiorityRule: V9 minus V8 primary-objective point estimate is below zero and its one-sided 95% bootstrap upper bound is below zero

requiredSafety: V9 full-coverage mean selected excess loss below V8
V9 full-coverage P90 selected excess loss below V8
V9 full-coverage P95 selected excess loss no more than 2% above V8
V9 dangerous false-champion share below V8
V9 60%-to-100% area under selection-risk curve below V8
V9 matched 70% coverage selection objective below V8
descriptive: family-specific mean, P90, P95, dangerous false-champion share, and oracle recall
paired business win, tie, and loss rates

primaryInference.estimand: V9 minus V8 full-coverage selection objective
